data.title: BMW offers US customers $500 in public charging credits for 2027 EVs
data.description: BMW North America is offering a new public charging package for customers purchasing or leasing eligible BEVs from its 2027 model year range. It includes $500 in charging credits and a free one-year membership at IONNA, giving customers a discount on charging sessions at the charging network.

data.title: JBM EV introduces Ecolife e12 electric bus in Singapore
data.description: Indian electric bus manufacturer JBM Electric Vehicles (JBM EV) has launched the Ecolife e12 in Singapore. The company introduced it at the biennial Singapore Urban Mobility Week, which is taking place from 4 to 6 November this year.

data.title: EVgo integrates first Tesla Superchargers into its network
data.description: EVgo has opened its first site with Tesla Superchargers near downtown Chicago. The twelve charging points mark the beginning of several hundred more Superchargers that the US charging network operator plans to integrate into its own network.

data.title: SNE Research: Chinese OEMs increasingly dominate global EV battery market
data.description: In the first nine months of this year, Chinese manufacturers secured more than half of the battery market for electric and hybrid vehicles outside China - while Korean and Japanese suppliers lost ground. This is according to a new analysis by SNE Research.

data.title: ZF develops <30,000 RPM electric drive
data.description: ZF has developed the High Revolution Drive, a particularly compact electric drive with up to 30,000 RPM. The supplier promises reduced installation space and weight, as well as a significantly lower magnet requirement.

data.title: Smart #2 celebrates market debut in China
data.description: Smart's two-seater electric city car is now being offered in China in the Premium trim line at a list price of 102,900 yuan - equivalent to just under €14,000 euros. The #2 is designed as the successor to the iconic Smart ForTwo and celebrated its world premiere in Paris in October.

data.title: Tesla to phase out Cybertruck production in Texas in favour of Cybercab
data.description: Tesla will phase out production of the Cybertruck at its Texas plant mid-next year. This will free up space to allow the Robotaxi Cybercab to be built in larger quantities. It remains unclear whether the Cybertruck will be completely discontinued or if it will be produced elsewhere in the future.

data.title: Volkswagen introduces battery preconditioning for older ID. models
data.description: Volkswagen is updating the functions of older electric cars in its ID family. With ID. Software 3.9.1, manual pre-conditioning of the high-voltage battery before DC fast charging is being introduced. This OTA update also improves thermal management, AC charging, and system stability, among other things.

data.title: Swiss companies aim to make Tesla’s Cybertruck road-legal in Europe
data.description: Werk.lab and Revoltaris are working to get the Tesla Cybertruck approved for Swiss certification. To achieve this, the electric pickup had to undergo technical revisions in several areas.

data.title: Waymo robotaxis occupy public charging stations in US cities in droves
data.description: Electric car drivers in some major US cities report that Waymo's robotaxis are regularly occupying public charging stations. "They come in droves," a resident told the Los Angeles Times. Cases have been reported in San Diego, Nashville, and St. Louis, among others.

data.title: India: Bihar Police to deploy 1,100 electric motorcycles
data.description: The police department of Bihar, a state in the eastern part of India, plans to deploy 1,100 electric motorcycles for patrolling operations. It has ordered these vehicles from Revolt Motors, one of the few electric motorcycle manufacturers in the country.

data.title: Quehenberger doubles its battery-electric truck fleet
data.description: Austrian logistics company Quehenberger is further expanding its electric truck fleet. By the end of 2026, the company - which operates for the drugstore chain dm, among others - will nearly double the number of its own e-trucks from 13 to 24 alongside building the necessary charging infrastructure.

data.title: UK BEV registrations reach annual high with 32 per cent market share
data.description: Registrations of new battery-electric cars rose by 32.7 per cent year-on-year in October, reaching 48,858 units. That's according to the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT), which said BEVs accounted for 32 per cent of the market - their highest share so far this year.

data.title: Kia EV2 Earth: Two weeks with Kia’s compact range marvel
data.description: A longstanding rule of thumb in electromobility has been that you either get long range or compact dimensions - you can't have both, especially not at an attractive price. After all, the battery has to fit somewhere. Kia wants to change that with its new EV2. This 4.06-meter-long compact car is available with an optional 61-kWh battery and a starting price tag of €26,600. We tested it for two weeks and were positively surprised by how the Koreans have created a genuinely attractive overall package using very simple means.

data.title: Kia EV7 and H2-Carnival in the works
data.description: Kia is apparently planning a battery-electric EV7 and a hydrogen-powered van from the Carnival series, which is available in certain markets. This is according to a Korean portal citing an internal company document that lists production plans for the coming years.

data.title: Mercedes-Benz starts assembling electric GLC in India
data.description: Mercedes-Benz has begun assembling the electric GLC from imported knocked-down kits at its plant in Chakan, near Pune in the Indian state of Maharashtra. Chakan is the second site for assembling the new EV from kits, after Thailand's Thonburi Automotive Assembly Plant (TAAP), and overall its fourth production site worldwide.

data.title: Ireland unveils new charging infrastructure strategy for 2028
data.description: Ireland aims to further expand its charging infrastructure by the end of 2028. A new national strategy includes additional fast-charging parks along major traffic routes and more charging options in residential areas.

data.title: LG Energy Solution launches battery research competition
data.description: LG Energy Solution launches the Battery Innovation Contest 2026. Universities and research institutions worldwide can submit proposals for new battery technologies until December 6. The focus includes battery materials, battery management, and AI.

data.title: PPC Blue to install fast chargers on Romanian motorway
data.description: Greek charging provider PPC Blue continues to expand in Romania, and is now installing and operating 30 fast-charging points along Romanian highway A7 in cooperation with Romanian oil company Oscar Downstream. Nearly half of the charging points will be suitable for electric trucks and buses.

data.title: Fraunhofer develops tool for battery recycling
data.description: Fraunhofer FFB and RWTH Aachen University have developed an evaluation model for the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. It allows different processes to be compared in terms of their costs and CO₂ emissions.
